daemons.title: Services (orchestrator + daemons)
daemons.name: Service
daemons.openTabs: Open log tabs for running daemons

config.title: Configuration (read-only)
config.hint: The source of truth is config.json; edit it on the Settings tab.

settings.title: Settings
settings.restartHint: Some changed fields require an orchestrator restart to take effect.
settings.daemonRestartNote: Fields with a "restart" badge take effect after the daemon is restarted (Services tab).

vad.label: VAD (strip non-speech)
vad.desc: Silero VAD removes music/silence before recognition — fixes whisper's looping. Off → the whole audio is transcribed.

vad_threshold.label: VAD threshold
vad_threshold.desc: Speech-detection threshold (0–1). Lower keeps more audio as speech (safer for quiet speech); higher trims more aggressively.

vad_speech_pad_ms.label: VAD speech pad (ms)
vad_speech_pad_ms.desc: Silence padding kept around speech segments so word edges aren't clipped.

no_speech_thold.label: No-speech threshold
no_speech_thold.desc: Drop a segment when the no-speech probability exceeds this (0–1). Higher = stricter against silence hallucinations.

entropy_thold.label: Entropy threshold
entropy_thold.desc: Repetition detection via text compressibility; triggers temperature fallback. whisper.cpp default is 2.4.

gpu.label: GPU
gpu.desc: Use the GPU for inference (if the build/drivers support it).

num_speakers.label: Speakers
num_speakers.desc: Fixed number of speakers, or -1 to detect automatically (diarization).

cluster_threshold.label: Cluster threshold
cluster_threshold.desc: Speaker clustering threshold — higher merges more voices into one speaker (diarization). Default 0.5.

min_duration_on.label: Min speech (s)
min_duration_on.desc: Minimum active-speech segment length, seconds (diarization). Default 0.2.

min_duration_off.label: Min silence (s)
min_duration_off.desc: Minimum silence gap between segments, seconds (diarization). Default 0.5.

max_workers.label: Workers
max_workers.desc: Max local python workers running at once (batch models in config.models: vosk, gemma, vibevoice…). Whisper goes through the ws-daemon and does NOT count here.

poll_interval_ms.label: Poll interval (ms)
poll_interval_ms.desc: How often the orchestrator re-scans the queue and drop folders.

stream_window_ms.label: Stream window (ms)
stream_window_ms.desc: Size of the audio window sent to the daemon per binary frame.

stream_chunk_ms.label: Stream chunk (ms)
stream_chunk_ms.desc: Max audio per streaming session; then a fresh session on a new connection.

daemon_registry_ttl_ms.label: Registry TTL (ms)
daemon_registry_ttl_ms.desc: A daemon is ready only if its heartbeat is within this TTL.

drop_stable_ms.label: Drop stability (ms)
drop_stable_ms.desc: A dropped file is claimed only after its mtime has been stable this long (guards against mid-copy).

max_requeue_attempts.label: Max requeue
max_requeue_attempts.desc: How many times to requeue a job on transport failure before failing it.

default_model.label: Default model
default_model.desc: Model used for jobs that don't specify one.

ffmpeg_path.label: ffmpeg path
ffmpeg_path.desc: Path to ffmpeg.exe used to convert audio to pcm16le 16k mono.

engine.label: Engine
engine.desc: Engine family for language routing (e.g. whisper).

model_name.label: Model
model_name.desc: Model name this daemon is bound to (ggml-<model>.bin file).

models.title: Models
models.hint: Download recognition models from HuggingFace. The script is idempotent — already-downloaded files are skipped.
models.notDownloadableWhy: A locally fine-tuned model — not in the public HF download manifest. It is provisioned by converting the HF model to ggml + staging it (see "Staged via").
models.cascadeNote: These instances will be removed too (cascade).
models.pollNote: Status refreshes automatically every few seconds.

fleet.removeConfirm: Remove instance {name}? (its config entry is deleted)
